messages:
maggie: Draft for the Optimize launch post is ready in drive. Main asks: 1) pick primary CTA (webinar vs gated benchmark) 2) quick legal language check on hero stat 3) confirm HubSpot naming + UTMs 4) finalize 15s snackable. Can we rapid-fire this? :eyes:

nora: Design needs the final hero sentence and CTA label to finish comps. I can have hero + 15s/30s exports by EOD if copy locks.

reza: Legal quick-pass: current hero says '50% cost reduction for all customers'  change to 'in our benchmark tests, Optimize reduced per-token inference cost by up to 50%'. Also appendix must include model, seq len, GPU, and raw numbers. I can sign off after appendix attached. :white_check_mark:

kai: Ops note: HubSpot workflows should be named: 'Launch - Optimize - Blog - Webinar' and 'Launch - Optimize - Blog - Benchmark'. Hidden field campaign_id=optimize_launch_2026 and source_detail={hero|sidebar}. PDF downloads -> tag 'benchmark_pdf' and set lifecycle=MQL if company_size>100. Webinar -> add to nurture list only.

samir: For experiments: primary hero -> 'Watch 90s demo' (low friction), secondary -> 'Download full benchmark' (gated). UTMs: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_content={video90|pdf_full}. Also propose A/B headline: stat-first vs benefit-first.

maggie: OK switched hero to legal wording: 'In our benchmark tests, Optimize reduced per-token inference cost by up to 50% while improving throughput by up to 3.2x. See appendix for test rig and raw results.' Pushed update to doc.

nora: Good  I'll render two hero variants (stat-first, narr-first) and produce a 15s stat snackable that opens with '3.2x throughput' then CTA overlay 'See full benchmark + register'. Uploading drafts to /cdn/marketing/optimize-launch/.

ops-bot: Publish checklist (template) created:
- final copy (maggie)
- legal sign-off (reza)
- hero image + video exports (nora)
- gated PDF uploaded (nora)
- HubSpot workflows staged (kai)
- UTMs decided (samir)

maggie: Great. Plan: publish Thu 09:00 PT if legal confirms appendix by EOD. Kai, leave workflows paused until I post publish time here. Nora, please add utm_content tags on video overlays per Samir.

reza: I'll review appendix now and post sign-off within 3 hours. If any dataset/config missing I'll flag it here.

samir: I'll draft two social copy variants and schedule experiments once assets are on CDN. Tag me when ready.

content-bot: Reminder: final publish checklist to run through 30m before scheduled time: hero image, CDN assets, HubSpot workflows unpaused, GA4 event mapping, short social queue.

maggie: Thanks all  locking draft pending legal. If approved I'll hit publish command tomorrow morning. :rocket:
